**Finding: missing (critical) — no IP/data ownership clause exists.**

- Reviewed §§1.1–1.8 (HDI designs, develops, hosts the Site at its own cost), §2.1 (we supply all Content), §5.2 (our editorial control only), §6.1 (our Marks licensed to HDI for its obligations), §7.1 (consent-gated reciprocal e-mail list cross-promotion), §8 (confidentiality) and §10 (general). Searches for "own", "Content", "intellectual property", "data" returned no ownership, assignment or licence-back language.
- Nothing assigns our IP or data to HDI (so not walk-away), but there is also no Company ownership of the developed Site/work product, no Company Data ownership, and no licence to us — failing both preferred and fallback.
- Cure: one inserted Section 5.5 carrying only the nine preferred elements, with a narrow reference to §7.1 so the reciprocal cross-promotion right we benefit from is not contradicted.
